title: Feed Noise and Chattiness Score
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal earliest=-7d
| stats count as events by sourcetype
| eval daily_events=round(events/7,1)
| sort - daily_events
description: Ranks which personal feeds generate the most event noise each day.
value: Noisy feeds can drown out the meaningful ones and make dashboards feel busier without becoming wiser.
implementation: Count events by sourcetype over the last week in `index=personal`; rank them by average daily event volume.
visualization: Leaderboard of sourcetypes by average daily events.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which personal feeds are the chattiest and may be creating more noise than insight.
